scope: Proprietary Data Load Segment 118, its dedicated Request/Response envelope (Section 11.7.6/11.7.7), its 13 core fields, and its five conditional Prompt-Code-specific payload variants (901 Custom Receipt Text, 902 Dynamic Card Table, 903 Site Configuration, 904 Host Discount, 905 Fuel Volume).
extractionEvidence: docs/specs/extracted_text.txt: Section 11.7.6/11.7.7 (pages 11-36 to 11-38), Section 12.16 and 12.16.1-12.16.5 (pages 12-37 to 12-45), Chapter 13 element catalog (Elements 11, 44, 55, 63, 77, 78, 83, 84, 85, 86, 102, 165, 166, 168-186, 201), and Appendix E (Valid Card Type Codes Used in Special Transaction Prompt Codes).

rules.title: Proprietary Data Load Segment requests or carries Customer Specific Proprietary data for loading (host-to-device push: Dynamic Card Table, Custom Receipt Text, Host Discounts) or capturing (device-to-host push: Site Configuration, Fuel Volume) at the BUYPASS FEP; functionally similar to Electronic Mail
Segment 118 has a maximum length of 3,800 alphanumeric characters (01-3,800) in a Request
Segment 118 has a maximum length of 3,800 alphanumeric characters (01-3,800) in a Response
Segment 118 originates at the device

In a Proprietary Data Load Request, all of fields 1-13 are separated by Field Separators, including unpopulated fields, and a Field Separator follows field 13; in a Proprietary Data Load Response, there are no Field Separators between fields (positional)
Segment Type (Element 85) is fixed value 118, Required, field 1
Segment Length (Element 84) is Required, field 2, and is 4 numeric digits (unlike the 3-digit Segment Length used by most other segments), including the Segment Type's length and Field Separators
Sequence Number (Element 86) is Required, field 3, 6 digits, and identifies the unique transaction sequence number for the life of the transaction

Information Byte (Element 44) is Required, field 4, 1 character, and indicates whether the request is a single-message or multimessage request; the complete value catalog is not shown in this workspace's source
Terminal Identifier (Element 102) is Required, field 5, 13 characters, identifying the device by Device Type, State Code, BUYPASS Merchant Number, and Device Number

Prompt Code (Element 78) is Required, field 6, 3 digits, and must be one of the five documented values: 901 (Custom receipt text), 902 (Dynamic card table), 903 (Site configuration data), 904 (Host discount data), 905 (Fuel volume data), per Appendix E's Valid Card Type Codes Used in Special Transaction Prompt Codes

Prompt Code, Pending (Element 182) is Required, field 7, 4 digits, and must be one of the documented values: 0901 (Custom Receipt Text Data), 0902 (Proprietary Data Load), 0904 (Host Discount Data), 0981 (Electronic Mail)

Device Card Table Version (Element 176) is Required, field 8, 35 numeric digits: seven 5-digit version values strung together for the Card Table Master ID, BIN table, RULES table, RESTRICTIONS table, SAF table, PROMPT table, and PRODUCT table versions; a value beginning with 99999 indicates no card table is used at the location

Card Table Load Version (Element 177) is Required, field 9, 35 numeric digits, representing the versions of the Card Table components currently being loaded; sourced from the Host and echoed back in each subsequent block request

Card Table Type (Element 174) is Required, field 10, 4 digits, identifying the specific table type this segment addresses, sourced from the Host and echoed back; valid values are 0001 (BIN Table), 0002 (RULES Table), 0003 (RESTRICTIONS Table), 0004 (SAF Table), 0005 (PROMPT Table), 0006 (PRODUCT Table)
Load Control Key (Element 178) is Required, field 11, 60 characters, sourced from the Host and echoed back in each subsequent block request
Host Discount Timestamp (Element 179) is Required, field 12, 12 digits, format CCYYMMDDHHMM, sourced from the Host

Block Number (Element 11) is Conditional, field 13, 3 digits, identifying the specific block being sent by device or Host; the Host uses this value to determine the next block to send, and it is echoed back in the subsequent block request

When Prompt Code is 901 (Custom Receipt Text Data, response only), fields 14-20 are: Start Date (165, 8, CCYYMMDD), Start Time (166, 4, HHMM), End Date (165, 8), End Time (166, 4), Number of Receipt Text Lines (168, 2), then a repeated Receipt Text Data Length (169, 2) / Receipt Text Data (170, 20) block for a total variable length up to 220 bytes; fields are not Field-Separated
When Prompt Code is 902 (Dynamic Card Table Data, response only), field 14 is Card Table Data (175, max 3,600 bytes, length determined by the Segment Length in field 2)
When Prompt Code is 903 (Site Configuration Data, request only), field 14 is Site Configuration Data (180, max 3,600 bytes, Source: Vendor); a Field Separator follows field 14

When Prompt Code is 904 (Host Discount Data, response only), fields 14-27 are: Host Discount Timestamp (179, 12), Number of Discounts (171, 2), then a repeated block of Start Date (165,8), Start Time (166,4), End Date (165,8), End Time (166,4), BUYPASS Card Type (173,4), Card BIN Range Beginning (183,12), Card BIN Range Ending (184,12), Product Code (77,3), Product Discount Amount (172,5), Product Code (77,3), Discount Quantity Limit (185,3), Discount Program Description (186,15), for a total variable length not to exceed 3,600 bytes
When Prompt Code is 905 (Fuel Volume Data, request only), field 14 is Fuel Volume Data (201, max 3,600 bytes, Source: Vendor); a Field Separator follows field 14

A Proprietary Data Load Request contains Data Section 1 (Elements 55, 63 with Number of Segments fixed value 1) and Data Section 3 (field 3, Segment 118, Required); it explicitly does not contain Data Section 2 / the Standard Message Data Segment (100)

A Proprietary Data Load Response contains Data Section 1 (Response Code 83 pos.1 len.1, Download Indicator 30 pos.2 len.1, Initiation Date 45 pos.3 len.6, Initiation Time 46 pos.9 len.4, Sequence Number 86 pos.13 len.6, all Required) and Data Section 3 (field 6, Segment 118, Required)

Response Code (Element 83) values specific to the Proprietary Data Load context: H (Approved, proprietary data retrieval more pending), O (Approved, proprietary data load more pending), T (Approved, proprietary data load, no more data pending), U (Declined, proprietary data load, no more data pending), X (Declined, proprietary data load, proceed to next pending Prompt Code), Y (Approved, proprietary data load, proceed to next pending Prompt Code)

For Site Configuration Data (Prompt Code 903), Block Number starts at 1 and increments with each block; Block Number = 0 is sent as a final message and carries no site configuration data; the associated Response Codes are T (Approved, no more data pending) and U (Declined, no more data pending)

Host Discount Data (Prompt Code 904) is triggered when a Totals Response's Response Code (83) indicates proprietary/host-discount data pending (values D/E for general proprietary data pending, M/N for Host Discount data pending specifically); the device then sends a Proprietary Data Load Request with Prompt Code 904

The discount amount from Host Discount Data is carried in a subsequent Financial Transaction Request's Product Code Data Segment (102) using Product Code 941 (negative amount, post-pay environment) or 991 (administrative amount, pre-pay environment)

Response Code (Element 83) values V (Declined, Totals with Proprietary Custom Receipt Text data pending) and W (Approved, Totals with Proprietary Custom Receipt Text pending) indicate that a Prompt Code 901 (Custom Receipt Text) load is pending, analogous to the Host Discount D/E/M/N pattern
